en.headline: Seasonal flu vaccination programme now under way
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the 2026-27 scheme, covering school outreach, residential homes and subsidised private clinics, began on Thursday.
body: Hong Kong's 2026-27 Seasonal Influenza Vaccination Programme began on Thursday, the Centre for Health Protection said, urging priority groups to get inoculated as soon as possible.

The programme covers the Seasonal Influenza Vaccination School Outreach Programme, the Residential Care Home Vaccination Programme and the Vaccination Subsidy Scheme. Eligible groups for free or subsidised jabs include people aged 50 or above, young children, pregnant women, and residents of residential care homes. Appointments at Hospital Authority family medicine clinics and public hospitals can be made through District Health Centre booking pages or the HA Go app.

The Department of Health has procured about 1.3 million doses across three platforms: injectable inactivated vaccine, nasal live attenuated vaccine and injectable recombinant vaccine. Centre for Health Protection Controller Dr Edwin Tsui Lo-kin said earlier that Hong Kong entered the influenza season at the end of June and that activity has remained high. He said unvaccinated elderly residents of care homes were about four times as likely to develop severe complications as those who had been vaccinated, and unvaccinated children about five times as likely.
Pneumococcal vaccination for older adults continues year-round. The centre advised that it takes about two weeks after a flu jab for adequate antibodies to develop.

zh.headline: 2026／27年度流感疫苗接種計劃已展開
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心表示，涵蓋學校外展、院舍注射及疫苗資助的計劃已於周四啟動，呼籲優先組別盡早接種。
body: 衞生防護中心表示，2026／27年度季節性流感疫苗接種計劃已於周四展開，呼籲優先接種人士盡快打針。
計劃包括季節性流感疫苗學校外展計劃、院舍防疫注射計劃及疫苗資助計劃。合資格免費或獲資助接種的組別包括50歲或以上人士、幼童、孕婦及院舍院友。如欲在醫管局家庭醫學診所及公立醫院接種，可透過地區康健中心預約網頁或「HA Go」應用程式預約。
衞生署本年度採購約130萬劑疫苗，涵蓋注射式滅活疫苗、噴鼻式減活疫苗及注射式重組疫苗三個技術平台。衞生防護中心總監徐樂堅較早前表示，本港自6月底進入流感季節，活躍程度仍處高水平。未接種疫苗的安老院舍長者出現嚴重併發症的比率約為已接種者的四倍，未接種的兒童則約為五倍。
長者肺炎球菌疫苗接種安排全年續續。中心提醒，接種流感疫苗後約需兩星期，身體才會產生足夠抗體。
